resources.string:
The bundled sky catalog includes data adapted by filtering and converting coordinates from:

HYG Database v4.1 by David Nash (Astronexus), compiled from Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star Catalog, and Gliese catalogs.
https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database

OpenNGC by Mattia Verga, built from NED, HyperLEDA, SIMBAD, HEASARC, and other documented sources.
https://github.com/mattiaverga/OpenNGC

The adapted catalog data in sky_catalog.json is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

This license notice covers catalog data only; AstroDroid source-code licensing is separate.
